root_cause.text: Including X86_CR4_FRED in the CR4 pinned bits mask prevents clearing the FRED bit during boot, creating a window where FRED MSRs are not yet initialized on all CPUs, leading to triple faults when exceptions occur in SEV-ES/SNP or TDX guests.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that during boot FRED is initialized on BSP first, then APs, and there is a window when exceptions cannot be handled because FRED MSRs are not set up yet, causing triple faults in SEV-{ES,SNP} or TDX guests. The patch removes X86_CR4_FRED from the pinned mask to avoid this issue.
